description:
CrlChecker::new, CrlChecker::with_delta, and OcspChecker::new are missing #[must_use]. The first-pass review (PKIX-kwd) added #[must_use] to constructors in pkix-path (TrustAnchor::new, TrustAnchor::from_cert, ValidationPolicy::new, names_match). The same convention should apply to the new revocation crate constructors introduced in the commits covered by this epic.

Files:
- pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:86 — CrlChecker::new
- pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:107 — CrlChecker::with_delta
- pkix-revocation/src/ocsp.rs:69 — OcspChecker::new
title: pkix-revocation: missing #[must_use] on constructors
